label: Scientific Papers
title: Scientific Papers
subtitle: Searches six academic sources in one query — arXiv, OpenAlex, PMC, Europe PMC, bioRxiv and medRxiv, and CORE.
whenToUse: Used when you want one sweep across preprints and published literature instead of visiting each source in turn. Preprint servers carry work months before it reaches a journal, so this is the tool for a fast-moving field.

methods.name: Search Papers
methods.description: Runs one query across the six sources and returns the matching papers merged into a single list.
